'''Grezor''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denova]] with a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of troops to take possession of the planet's [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]], but the majority of the battalion was corrupted by the [[Dread Masters]].
